title: Finance Core — real application / synthetic data
source: Isolated local application and synthetic SQLite database. Source repositories and raw captures remain private.

audio.composition: Original locally synthesized A-minor / F / C / G pads and sparse bell motifs; no samples or third-party music.
audio.method: Deterministic additive synthesis, stereo equal-power panning; soft sine clicks only on recorded pointerdown events.

disclosure: DEMO throughout. Synthetic data; no connected bank, live market data or external AI. GoCardless is implemented read-only but not configured; no external integration is demonstrated end-to-end.
limits: Crypto shows local quantities and recorded cost only; no prices, P&L, wallet connection or trading.
Manual investment accounts are not a brokerage integration. Net worth is not all liquid cash.
Savings scenarios are estimates, not financial advice or audited forecasts.
Local SQLite walkthrough does not validate production PostgreSQL migrations or external integrations.
editing: Original dark cards and chapter frames; brief dips to dark; real-time UI clips. Actual pointer events drive an in-capture cursor/halo and frame-quantized soft click sounds. No invented click cues, response mocks, speed changes or third-party audio.

chapters.en: Finance Core. A real application walkthrough using synthetic data.
chapters.es: Finance Core. Un recorrido por la aplicación real, con datos sintéticos.

chapters.en: Net worth, income and expenses in one view. All data in this demonstration is fictitious.
chapters.es: Patrimonio, ingresos y gastos en una vista. Los datos de esta demostración son ficticios.

chapters.en: Accounts grouped by institution. Net worth includes manual investments; it is not all liquid cash.
chapters.es: Cuentas agrupadas por entidad. El patrimonio incluye inversión manual; no es todo dinero líquido.

chapters.en: The read-only GoCardless connector requires provider configuration and consent. It is not configured here.
chapters.es: El conector GoCardless de solo lectura requiere proveedor y consentimiento. Aquí no está configurado.

chapters.en: The local alternative: select a synthetic CSV and review its preview before confirming.
chapters.es: La alternativa local: seleccionar un CSV sintético y revisar la vista previa antes de confirmar.

chapters.en: After confirming two rows, preview the file again: duplicate protection prevents counting them twice.
chapters.es: Tras confirmar dos filas, se repite la vista previa: la protección de duplicados evita volver a contarlas.

chapters.en: Analytics summarize income, spending and savings trends from local transactions.
chapters.es: La analítica resume tendencias de ingresos, gastos y ahorro a partir de movimientos locales.

chapters.en: An extra-savings scenario helps explore goals. It is an estimate, not a financial promise.
chapters.es: Un escenario de ahorro extra ayuda a explorar objetivos. Es una estimación, no una promesa financiera.

chapters.en: Local crypto holdings: quantities and recorded cost. No market prices, P&L, connected wallets or trading.
chapters.es: Criptoactivos locales: cantidades y coste registrado. Sin cotizaciones, P&L, wallets conectadas ni operaciones.

chapters.en: Real application, synthetic data. No connected banks, live prices or external AI. Source code remains private.
chapters.es: Aplicación real, datos sintéticos. Sin bancos conectados, precios en vivo ni IA externa. Código privado.

requests.description: Real local authenticated application requests; no bank, market or AI provider calls. Bodies, headers, paths and raw logs remain private.

sourceTiming.method: DOM events use performance.timeOrigin + performance.now, mapped to a process-monotonic clock. Actual CDP screencast timestamps define each clip origin. Click sounds round to the nearest 25fps frame; no invented timestamps.

inputMethod: Guided Playwright mouse, keyboard, native-select and file-input actions. No application data or API responses replaced. The only presentation overlay is the actual-event-driven pointer and click halo.
